## Mapped classes

No class is mapped at skos:closeMatch or stronger in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Implement ecological restoration treatments and adapt them to site response — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Recognize and assess ecosystems that have crossed into novel states — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Plan and run field campaigns and remote logistics — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Manage client and partner scope for environmental work — journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Develop proposals and grant applications for environmental work — journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Detect, treat and monitor invasive species in the field — journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Install and maintain erosion control and watershed treatments — journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Apply systems thinking across ecological, institutional and technical systems — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Develop and manage partnerships for shared environmental goals — senior L2, lead L3
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Run the adaptive management cycle and evaluate programme performance — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3, lead L4
- Practise cultural humility in community, field and team work — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Conduct participatory and community-based environmental research — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
